name: TUT catheter system
full_name: TUT catheter operating system with real-catheter master and clamp-relay slave
group: Tianjin University of Technology, Tianjin Key Laboratory for Control Theory & Applications in Complicated Industry Systems (Xu Ma), with Tianjin University of Technology and Education
versions: 2020 robotic catheter manipulation system with BP-neural-network PID (ma2020_development, title); 2021 new catheter operating system (ma2021_design)
force_sensing: proximal thrust measured during insertion; force sensor UNCSR and torque sensor OPT-563B listed (ma2021_design, PMC HTML)
haptics_leader: real catheter used as the input handle on a pulley; DC motor with encoder on the pulley gives force/torque feedback
validation_detail: simulation and axial-displacement bench tests only; no phantom or animal (ma2021_design)
key_numbers: axial stroke 300 mm, push/withdraw 30 mm/s; BP-PID max axial error < 1.5 mm, mean 0.48 mm; step-response overshoot 20% (PID) vs 12% (BP-PID) in simulation; Maxon EC32 axial motor; DSP TMS320F28335, serial 19200 baud (ma2021_design)
sim_model: none found (controller simulated as a mass-spring-damper only)
